title: Treadwear Adjustment and Workmanship Replacement on One Tire — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Under the Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty, treadwear adjustment and workmanship replacement are mutually exclusive for the same tire.

- One inspection supports either a treadwear adjustment or a workmanship replacement for its position, never both.
- When the technician has identified a manufacturing defect, the tire is handled as a workmanship replacement even if it is also worn, because the defect, not the mileage, ended its life.
- A position already adjusted for treadwear is out of the warranty and cannot later be replaced for workmanship.
- A position replaced for workmanship carries the replacement tire forward on the same set with the set's original purchase date, install odometer and warranted miles, so a later treadwear adjustment of that position measures miles from the install odometer exactly as before.

| Position's history | Treadwear adjustment later | Workmanship replacement later |
|---|---|---|
| Adjusted for treadwear | — (once per position) | not available |
| Replaced for workmanship | available, miles from the original install odometer | — |

**Example (hypothetical tire):** a tire recorded with a belt shift and 3/32 in of tread is handled as a workmanship replacement, not adjusted for treadwear.
